author: LunacyTwo
body:
Classes and specializations were wonky for me early on so here goes: 
Classes are permanent unlocks, and they also permanently unlock skills for your character at certain level thresholds. At certain points in the game, orns will become dispensable enough that classes a couple tiers below you are worth picking up for their skills, usually buff skills. Classes also have some non-permanent bonuses, such as their weapon affinity or passive skills, that are only active while you are that class. Also, classes can only equip gear of the types they state they can: warrior, mage, or thief. Some classes can wear gear of multiple classes. Be wary of upgrading gear that you won’t be able to even equip after using the next class. On a related note, classes also have a prerequisite class they require to unlock, so if you have a long term goal, make sure you plan accordingly.

Specializations are different. They are not permanent unlocks; once you switch specializations, you need to pay again to switch back, unlike classes that you can switch between at will. All skills, passives, weapon bonuses, stat bonuses, etc from that specialization are lost when switching specializations. Notably, YOUR FIRST SPECIALIZATION IS FREE. People often highly recommend skipping your T3 specialization and waiting for T5.

author: LazySoloDev
body:
* Play the class you like.    
* Get in a kingdom as soon as you can: you get experienced people to ask advices and raids to get xp and loot.    
* The higher tier you are the more you have to think about what you want to play next tier (there is a class tree you can check online).     
* Buffs and debuffs are very important later, especially for long fights.    
* Arena is a good way to get golds early. Also you will have a looooot of arena tokens later, so don't be afraid to use it.    
* Farming bosses while being in transportation (public or passenger in a car) is a reaaaaaally good way to progress. When doing so don't forget to pop an exp potion, and both coins.    
* Unless you're doing a lot of boss farm while in a bus/subway/car, you'll lack dungeon keys for a while. You will get more around T7 because T7 boss dungeons usually yield more than 5 keys.     
* Use orna asses tool online to check your gear stats. Your super duper mega item from T4 probably looks better than your not-looking-that-great T5 new item. But at lvl 10 the T5 may be better.    
* Pets are very useful and may help you cover your weaknesses.    
* When you're not feeling like you lack money, buy every material and arena token and rods from shops.     

Feel free to PM me if you have any questions later on. I'm not very experienced but I will gladly help!

author: Toptunovv
body:
Do the story questline as you progress, otherwise if you lvl up fast outleveling the quest tier, it will be more difficult to find the monsters.

Also do achievements like crazy, they give you good orn rewards for low level.
